disclosures: Ranks use confidence-adjusted effective trait values; raw calibrated values remain visible.
No-read teams remain unranked rather than receiving a league-average rank.
GM and manager composites are equal-weight summaries of available traits, not performance or quality grades.
Rookie opportunity is measured as first-NHL-season skater games divided by all skater games; it is season usage, not an opening-night roster claim.
Veteran preference is measured as age-30-or-older skater games divided by all skater games, with age measured on October 1.
Lineup patience uses the share of team skater-games supplied by the 18 most-used skaters.
Physical fourth-line preference uses bottom-half forward games from players producing at least eight hits per 60 minutes.
Four-line usage uses the share of forward games supplied by forwards averaging at least eight minutes.
Players listing multiple teams are assigned to the final team in the NHL summary row; this avoids double-counting but does not split traded-player statistics by stint.
Waiver protection, trades, deadline buying, matchups, tactical changes, off-position use, and fatigue rotation remain NoRead pending their authoritative adapters.
